name: Home Assistant Room Lights
author: Jane Doe
description: Control a camera's room light in Home Assistant from its camera view — on/off, brightness, and colour — with the server and camera→light mapping you configure.

settings.label: Home Assistant URL
settings.help: Use a LAN IP or a real DNS name — a .local/mDNS address will not resolve inside the container.

settings.label: Long-lived access token
settings.help: Home Assistant → your profile → Long-lived access tokens. Stored privately and never shown again.

settings.label: Camera → light
settings.help: Map each camera to the Home Assistant light entity to control while you are viewing it.
